On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Pitt Meadows total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Central Meadows Condos and Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: Central Meadows is Pitt Meadows' civic core, and its condo stock stands on one street: Harris Road.

The City's official name for this ground is the Municipal Town Centre in the official community plan (OCP), around Harris Road, City Hall at 12007 Harris Road, Lougheed Highway at the north edge and the CPKC rail line along Hammond Road to the south.
The Advent Road pocket at the south-west edge, around 18960 Advent Road, is board-classified Central Meadows even though it sits beside Highland Park.

blocks.text: Central Meadows Condos and Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: Meadowlands Housing Co-operative at 19032 Advent Road is not a strata at all: the Canadian Housing Federation of BC (CHF BC) directory lists it as a 55-plus co-operative with one- and two-bedroom homes, bought through membership, not a strata lot.

blocks.text: Central Meadows Condos and Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A co-operative home at 19032 Advent Road has no Form B Information Certificate, because the Strata Property Act diligence package does not apply to a housing co-operative the way it does to Solaris or Origin.

blocks.text: Central Meadows Condos and Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: City Hall at 12007 Harris Road, the Pitt Meadows Family Recreation Centre at 12027 Harris Road and the library at 200-12099 Harris Road all stand on the same corridor as the two condo buildings.
Meadowtown Shopping Centre at 19800 Lougheed Highway sits at this sub-area's north-east edge, not in Mid Meadows.
The R3 Lougheed Highway RapidBus stops at Harris Road on Lougheed Highway, giving this corridor a second rapid service besides the West Coast Express.
Harris Road is being studied by the City as a Complete Street under its Active Transportation Plan — see the municipal projects page.
The Harris Road rail crossing is the subject of a City project to separate road and rail traffic at Harris Road — see the municipal projects page.

blocks.text: Central Meadows Condos and Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Even the civic core is mapped floodplain work: check a Harris Road lot against Floodplain Bylaw No. Designation and Construction Control Bylaw No. 2384, 2008 - Consolidated.pdf
The CPKC rail line along Hammond Road bounds this sub-area to the south, so south-facing Harris Road units carry a rail-noise question the strata minutes, not a map, will answer.
For a 2008–2010 building like Origin or Solaris, the first mandatory depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund (CRF) balance on the Form B are the levy-risk documents.

blocks.text: Central Meadows home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

30 townhomes sold in Central Meadows with a median price of $715,000 (the middle half sold between $637,000 and $827,500), taking a median of 12 days to sell at 98.0% of the last list price; 10% sold above list. They had a median $513 per square foot, a median year built of 1990 and a median strata fee of $381 a month. 20 condos sold in Central Meadows with a median price of $520,000 (the middle half sold between $471,175 and $561,500), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 96.4% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $471 per square foot, a median year built of 1994 and a median strata fee of $509 a month.

faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 24 condos and townhomes listed in Central Meadows. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Central Meadows?

faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Central Meadows had a sales ratio of 38%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
faq.q: Is Central Meadows a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?

faq.a: 34 condos and townhomes sold in Central Meadows over those 5 months, out of 77 in all of Pitt Meadows.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Central Meadows from June to October 2026?

faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?

faq.a: They are different tenures on the same Advent Road pocket, and only one is a strata purchase. Meadowland Village at 18960 Advent Road is a freehold strata townhome complex where a buyer gets title to a strata lot and a Form B package. Meadowlands at 19032 Advent Road is a housing co-operative listed by CHF BC, where the buyer holds membership shares instead of strata title.
faq.q: What is the difference between Meadowland Village and the Meadowlands co-op?

faq.a: Pitt Meadows Elementary stands at 11941 Harris Road, on the same corridor as Solaris and Origin, and teaches kindergarten to grade 7. Always rerun the exact unit address in the School District 42 locator, because catchments here are address-based.
faq.q: Which elementary school serves a Harris Road condo?

faq.a: Directory lines are not bylaws, so a pet owner should read the registered bylaws attached to the Form B for the specific building rather than relying on either line. The two Harris Road buildings do not share one pet rule.

Pitt Meadows Station is on Harris Road in this sub-area, which is why Central Meadows is the city's commuter core. The City's transportation page describes West Coast Express service from that station toward Waterfront Station in Vancouver. No other Pitt Meadows sub-area contains a station, so a Harris Road condo and a Bonson Road townhome have materially different commutes on the same city page set.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Central Meadows sell for?
faq.a: 30 townhomes sold in Central Meadows between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $715,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Central Meadows?
faq.a: The median was 12 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.0% of the last list price (10% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
